hypothesis: A decoder-rebuilt WRT event representation with explicit match distance and length can create coded events not captured by probability calibration and retain enough independent full-corpus gain to enlarge the endpoint428 score margin.
kill_condition: Matched explicit-copy MDL is non-positive after opcodes, distance, length, and code bytes, or gain is concentrated in opening-prefix events and fails disjoint transfer.
promotion_condition: Exact held-out target-substrate replay clears counted code cost and the calibrated full-corpus debt, followed by a constructive disjoint-prefix roundtrip with bounded memory.
rejection_reason: The optimistic 1M target-trace screen saves 219.52 bytes after opcode/distance/length, but identifying 850 starts among 489989 events has a 1126.81-byte information lower bound, leaving a 907.28-byte deficit before native source cost.
title: WRT-native explicit residual copy coder
